approach: Build a drawer-specific state machine with four helpers: sense, plan, lease, and persist. Phases are restore/revalidate, identify middle drawer, measure handle and approach, align open jaws, close, test outward engagement, incrementally pull, release/retreat, and verify. The images suggest three cabinet pulls; runtime observations must establish their ordering and the requested cabinet identity. Use local handle geometry rather than whole-cabinet registration. Never lift the drawer: test and pulling motions follow its measured outward direction. Persist phase intent before commands and acknowledged jaw transitions before subsequent sensing. Completion requires the actual middle drawer to remain visibly open after release, not merely an attained hand pose. Return completion_proposed and bounded JSON evidence, distinguishing proposal from native evaluation.
observations: sense uses api.state, api.review with declared fields, and current named point/region measurements. Request handle ordering, middle-pull endpoints and exposed shaft samples, front-plane interior samples, fixed carcass landmarks, drawer seams, table surfaces, and relevant obstacles. Separate same-body identity, landmark correspondence, obstruction, visibility, and unknown. Keep requests below 32 points and 8 regions; inspect measurement_errors before indexing. Use api.camera and api.plane_point only for visible boundaries belonging to a validated measured plane. Optionally initialize a textured drawer patch with track_init; otherwise use physically defined handle mounts/seams. track_update must provide adequate current evidence, using frame_id and reference_frame_id. Save references before motion. After interventions invalidate affected geometry, retaining only justified stationary carcass evidence. Every sense call returns valid, contradicted, or inconclusive with provenance and componentwise uncertainty; invalid depth and inadequate fits trigger bounded alternatives, not unconditional exceptions.
geometry: Use geo.plane coefficients for the drawer-front plane; orient its normal outward using handle protrusion and cabinet identity. Measured shaft endpoints define the handle tangent. Use geo.rotation, geo.pad_position, and own_geometry to evaluate open-jaw approach and closed-jaw finger envelopes. Search at most 18 configurations: three shaft locations, three feasible approach rolls, and two insertion depths derived from measured available intervals. Include handle thickness, finger/front clearance, table clearance, and neighboring pulls. For interval contact overlap m, translation satisfies c+m-b <= t <= d-m-a, with 0<m<=min(b-a,d-c). Distinguish nominal feasibility, conservative feasibility over explicit componentwise hypotheses, and observed effects; fit residuals are not calibrated confidence. Share correlated plane/calibration errors rather than counting them repeatedly. Measure drawer displacement relative to the carcass and compare independently measured drawer/hand motion using geo.attachment_error where correspondences permit. Choose stopping tolerances from remaining geometric slack, respecting controller minima and deadbands.
gate_dependencies: Identification needs current evidence of the middle pull, not hidden drawer state. A noncontact approach needs a locally justified path and no observed obstruction, not certified visibility of the eventual pull route. Closing needs measured handle/jaw alignment and feasible local finger placement; attachment is not a prerequisite. A short outward test needs a current identified drawer reference, current hand state, and local clearance. Its subsequent differential measurement establishes engagement and sliding response; neither gripper acknowledgment nor TCP motion suffices. Further pulls need consistent drawer response and a newly assessed outward corridor, not full-shape registration. Release follows measured opening. Final verification checks the correct drawer's exposed cavity, increased seam/front-to-carcass separation, hand disengagement, and persistence after retreat. Unknown evidence never becomes success or physical impossibility.
bounded_recovery: At every sensing site, allow at most two distinct alternatives: another visible landmark/region or camera, then a locally justified observation action. Before contact this can be a standoff viewpoint change; while holding, use fresh drawer references followed by a short axial differential test, not an arbitrary camera swing. Never retry unchanged hidden marks. Search remaining configurations after proxy rejection; allow at most three physical grasp trials. A failed trial requires measured disengagement and clearance before repositioning. Tracker unknown is not loss; measured slip or blockage stops pulling. After release, seek evidence without regrasping merely because visibility is missing. Cap pulling at 12 legs, six control calls each. Budget at most 192 control calls: 60 approach/views, 36 grasp/recovery, 72 pulling, 24 release; reserve three reviews for final assessment within 23 total. Recompute remaining work against actual progress and resources. Preserve continuity in four checkpoints below 8 KB each.
jev_contract: Send Jev program-derived phase, identified geometry, uncertainties, admissible candidates, local constraints, targets, and previous receipts; Jev supplies neither measurements nor Python execution. Use at most eight api.choose calls, each with 2..8 explicitly defined admissible alternatives, including stop; instructions identify their feature selectors. Every physical update, including recovery and release, uses api.control or a bounded api.drive lease. Supply exactly x,y,z,rx,ry,rz,gripper questions: negative/hold/positive mean decreasing/holding/increasing the specified world component; gripper choices are open/close/keep. Host residual magnitudes, deadbands, L2 limits, and 1..3 steps apply; dispatch Jev answers unchanged. Inspect acknowledged_steps and measured residuals; before/after are TCP lists, so obtain full states separately. Recompute stale features between leases. Persist receipts and independently check object effects. Report numerical failed margins, unknowns, observed failures, resource exhaustion, and programming errors distinctly.
